issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §5.5.7 toQuantity(unit) / convertsToQuantity(unit); §6.1.1 (commensurable units must convert)
issues.evidence: Python fallback returned empty/false for derived-unit and direct-key conversions that native and equality semantics accept: (1000 'J').toQuantity('kJ') -> [] vs native [1 'kJ']; (1 'kJ').toQuantity('J') -> [] vs [1000 'J']; (1 'm2').convertsToQuantity('cm2') -> false vs true; (1 'kJ').toQuantity('kg.m2/s2') -> [] vs [1000 'kg.m2/s2']. Probe: .temp/qa/fp08_explorer3_2026_08_17/probe.py
issues.root_cause: FP_Quantity.conv_unit_to (fhir4ds/fhirpath/engine/nodes.py) only entered base-reduction when _unit_reduces_to_base(fromUnit) was true, and that helper deliberately returns False for direct _ucum_base_conversion_factor keys — so the entire derived-unit families (J/kJ/N/kN/W/kW/V/mV) and exponent-suffixed keys (m2/cm2) never reached the base bridge in the fallback.
issues.resolution: Added a direct-key base bridge in conv_unit_to: when the from-unit is a direct table key and the to-unit is convertible, reduce both via conv_unit_to_base and convert on matching base units, excluding the seconds base unit ('s') so §5.5.7/§6.1 calendar-vs-UCUM doctrines (1 year -> 's' empty, 1 month = 1 'mo' empty) and offset-temperature rejections stay intact. Rendering uses _divide_and_render (28-sig-digit Decimal parity).

issues.evidence: Non-terminating metric conversions rendered at binary64 15 significant digits natively vs 28-digit Decimal in the fallback: (1 'kPa').toQuantity('mm[Hg]').toString() -> native 7.50063755419211 'mm[Hg]' vs python 7.500637554192106329037968227 'mm[Hg]'. Surfaced by the QA-001 fix extending exact Decimal rendering to the fallback's metric path.
issues.root_cause: Native convertQuantityUnit used exactDecimalRatioText only for the §5.5.7 duration table; the metric/derived base path still used the binary64 shortest-round-trip mask (15 sig figs).
issues.resolution: Added decimalFactorRatio() (exact integer numerator/denominator for plain-decimal conversion factors) and an exact rendering branch in convertQuantityUnit's metric path routing through exactDecimalRatioText (28 sig digits ROUND_HALF_EVEN, trailing-zero trim for exact quotients), with guards falling back to the binary64 path. Extension rebuilt and redeployed (repo bundle, site-packages, ~/.duckdb caches).

issues.evidence: (5 'mg').toQuantity('') returns the input and convertsToQuantity('') returns true in BOTH engines (empty-string unit behaves as the no-argument form); ' ' (space) correctly returns false/empty in both. Shared convention, no fixture pins it.
